🗓 **TAWG Daily Catch-up**
_2026-11-21 23:00 → 2026-11-22 23:00 UTC_

## ⚡ **Highlights**

> **A sizer PR became a soundness checkpoint** — the ShardDagProof proof-size work drew a point-by-point read-set review that separated verifier inputs from witness data and flagged open checks. [PR #48 review](https://github.com/trustless-ai/zkIE/pull/48#pullrequestreview-6009620084)

## 🤝 **What moved**

### zkIE proving stack

_The proving stack moved into a focused soundness and performance review phase._

- Jimmy Shi **Opened** PR #47, a proving-stack refactor that pairs soundness hardening with a performance overhaul, giving the team a single place to review changes that downstream proofs depend on. [PR #47](https://github.com/trustless-ai/zkIE/pull/47)

### zkIE proof sizing

_The proof-size tooling gained a concrete example and a sharper correctness conversation._

- echo-merlini **Shipped** a field-element proof-size sizer for ShardDagProof with a GPT-2 example, giving the team an early read on proof size when shaping configurations. [PR #48](https://github.com/trustless-ai/zkIE/pull/48)
- Jimmy Shi **Flagged** that plain `prove_argmax` leaves `sel_evals` empty, catching a wiring gap that could otherwise slip into the proving code unnoticed. [comment](https://github.com/trustless-ai/zkIE/pull/48#discussion_r4656111801)
- Jimmy Shi **Clarified** that the gather-matmul values under review are verifier inputs rather than witness data, drawing a boundary future op checks can follow. [comment](https://github.com/trustless-ai/zkIE/pull/48#discussion_r4656111804)
- Jimmy Shi **Traced** how both values reach `verify_virtual` as point arguments in scatter-add, making the argument flow explicit so the read-set discussion can converge on the right check. [comment](https://github.com/trustless-ai/zkIE/pull/48#discussion_r4656111808)
- Jimmy Shi **Mapped** that the permutation check only covers the `a_side` and `b_side` halves, marking exactly where extra coverage is needed. [comment](https://github.com/trustless-ai/zkIE/pull/48#discussion_r4656111810)

## 🚀 **Next up**

### 💡 **Ideas to follow**

- Whether the field-element sizer should become the default estimate path for ShardDagProof configurations across the team.
- Documenting the verifier-input versus witness split so future gadgets inherit the same boundary.
- Whether the proving-stack refactor suggests a shared checklist for soundness and performance reviews.

### ✅ **TODOs**

- Resolve the open argmax, permutation, and virtual-point questions on PR #48, then re-check the GPT-2 example against the clarified inputs.
- Give PR #47 a focused soundness pass before the performance changes settle.

## 🤖 **Trusty's take**

> **Today's spark:** A proof-size sizer arrived and promptly drew a point-by-point soundness review, turning a focused change into a real correctness conversation.
>
> Keep that rhythm going, team — a sizer can estimate the size, but it takes a curious read-through to find the questions that matter 😄
